Maula Maula Mere Maula Maula Mere Maula Maula Maula

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
s = Path('src/data/lyrics/karam.md').read_text()
_, meta, body = s.split('---', 2)
roman = meta.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1]
def groups(text):
    return [block.splitlines() for block in text.strip().split('\\n\\n')]
r = groups('\\n'.join(line.removeprefix('  ') for line in roman.splitlines()))
u = groups(body)
assert [len(g) for g in r] == [len(g) for g in u] == [2, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3]
assert [g[0] for g in u[1:]] == list('۱۲۳۴۵')
assert [g[0] for g in r[1:]] == list('12345')
assert 'noUrdu' not in meta and 'direction: \"rtl\"' in meta
print('Verified 12 aligned verses across the opening and five couplets.')
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed all 12 Urdu verses in `karam.md` and verified that they align with `romanLyrics` across the opening and five couplets. Updated the title to `کرم`, kept `Karam` as the Roman title, set the direction to right-to-left, and removed the `noUrdu` tag.

I treated the opening line naming Shahid Baltistani and Ramadan 2021 as an import heading and omitted it from the lyrics. I rendered the ambiguous `bachday` as `بچڑے` and preserved `Takallum` as `تکلم` in the verse.
